items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: because I remember I got him a set of xylophones

ctx.x: I remember back in Chicago, we played in Chicago in the Defender band together. I've seen him come a long ways and I thought maybe we could -

No, Lionel - you got to sacrifice something, so he went to the vibes and the sensational things that he got to. When he was with Benny I used to go down to the Paramount Theatre, because I remember I got him a set of xylophones, because xylophones is fast. Vibraphones are slow with electronics. That gave him his speed, so naturally when he'd practice on those and go to the vibraphones it was not too difficult. He hadn't met Red Norvo, you see. I said, get with Red Norvo.
